natural.label: Natural Conversation
natural.text: Right, and notice this. Genesis does not begin with us. It begins with God. That changes the whole frame of the conversation.

reflective.label: Warm & Reflective
reflective.text: Hmm, notice where Genesis begins. Before our plans, our questions, or our worries, the story begins with God. Sit with that for a moment.

energetic.label: Energetic Discussion
energetic.text: Right, and this is the part I love. [chuckle] Genesis does not start with us at the center. It starts with God, and that changes the whole conversation.

serious.label: Serious / Difficult Passage
serious.text: Genesis chapter three changes the atmosphere. The passage moves into mistrust, shame, blame, and exile. We should slow down here and let the text carry its own weight.
